items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: that's the first time that I run into, uh, Charlie Crest and Faith Merrill.

ctx.x: we started... The first time we played after Hopeloos was Lafayette, Louisiana. That's where, uh, Haddock Hall originated, too. LeBlanc, you know, made Haddock Hall there.

And then, then we went on up north. We played all around the big town. St. Louis. And when I got to St. Louis on the medicine show, that's the first time that I run into, uh, Charlie Crest and Faith Merrill. Uh-huh.
Well, Faith Merrill was, was he playing on the boat? That's right.
